title: 中央政治局第十一次集体学习
title_en: 11th group study session of the CPC Central Committee Political Bureau
quote: 以劳动者、劳动资料、劳动对象及其优化组合的跃升为基本内涵，以全要素生产率大幅提升为核心标志，特点是创新，关键在质优，本质是先进生产力。
quote_en: Its basic connotation is the leap in workers, means of labour, objects of labour and their optimal combination; its core hallmark is a substantial increase in total factor productivity; its defining feature is innovation, its key lies in quality, and its essence is advanced productive forces.
summary: 2024-01-31 中央政治局第十一次集体学习，新华社 2024-02-01 电。同文：“新质生产力本身就是绿色生产力。”
summary_en: Group study session held on 2024-01-31; Xinhua dispatch dated 2024-02-01. The same text states: “New quality productive forces are in themselves green productive forces.”

title: 习近平总书记在黑龙江考察（新时代推动东北全面振兴座谈会等）
title_en: General Secretary Xi Jinping's inspection tour of Heilongjiang (including the symposium on promoting the full revitalisation of Northeast China in the new era)
summary: 2023-09-06 至 08 在黑龙江考察，首次提出“新质生产力”；新华社《第一观察》2023-09-10 亦有报道。
summary_en: Inspection of Heilongjiang from 2023-09-06 to 08, where “new quality productive forces” was proposed for the first time; also reported in Xinhua’s “First Observation” on 2023-09-10.
quote: 整合科技创新资源，引领发展战略性新兴产业和未来产业，加快形成新质生产力。
quote_en: Integrate scientific and technological innovation resources, lead the development of strategic emerging industries and future industries, and accelerate the formation of new quality productive forces.

title: 2023 年中央经济工作会议
title_en: 2023 Central Economic Work Conference
quote: 要以科技创新推动产业创新，特别是以颠覆性技术和前沿技术催生新产业、新模式、新动能，发展新质生产力。
quote_en: We must use scientific and technological innovation to drive industrial innovation, especially using disruptive and frontier technologies to spawn new industries, new models and new growth drivers, and develop new quality productive forces.
summary_en: Held on 11–12 December 2023.

title: “东数西算”工程全面启动：8 个国家算力枢纽节点、10 个国家数据中心集群
title_en: East Data, West Computing launched in full: 8 national computing hubs and 10 national data-centre clusters
summary: 8 枢纽：内蒙古、宁夏、甘肃、成渝、贵州、京津冀、长三角、粤港澳；10 集群：张家口、长三角生态绿色一体化发展示范区、芜湖、韶关、天府、重庆、贵安、和林格尔、庆阳、中卫。集群内数据中心平均上架率目标至少 65%。
summary_en: 8 hubs: Inner Mongolia, Ningxia, Gansu, Chengdu–Chongqing, Guizhou, Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei, the Yangtze River Delta and the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area; 10 clusters: Zhangjiakou, the Yangtze River Delta Eco-Green Integrated Development Demonstration Zone, Wuhu, Shaoguan, Tianfu, Chongqing, Gui'an, Horinger, Qingyang and Zhongwei. Target average rack utilisation of data centres within clusters: at least 65%.
quote: 集群内数据中心的平均上架率至少要达到65%以上
quote_en: The average rack utilisation of data centres within the clusters should reach at least 65%

title: 《国务院关于深入实施“人工智能+”行动的意见》（国发〔2025〕11号）
title_en: Opinions of the State Council on Deepening the Implementation of the “AI Plus” Initiative (Guo Fa [2025] No. 11)
summary: 2025-08-21 印发、08-26 公布。到 2027 年新一代智能终端、智能体等应用普及率超 70%，到 2030 年超 90%，到 2035 年全面步入智能经济和智能社会发展新阶段。六大行动：科学技术、产业发展、消费提质、民生福祉、治理能力、全球合作。
summary_en: Issued on 2025-08-21 and published on 08-26. By 2027 the adoption rate of new-generation intelligent terminals, AI agents and similar applications should exceed 70%, by 2030 exceed 90%, and by 2035 China should fully enter a new stage of development as an intelligent economy and intelligent society. Six major actions: science and technology, industrial development, consumption upgrading, people’s livelihood and well-being, governance capacity, and global cooperation.
quote: 到2027年，……新一代智能终端、智能体等应用普及率超70%……到2030年，……新一代智能终端、智能体等应用普及率超90%
quote_en: By 2027, … the adoption rate of new-generation intelligent terminals, AI agents and similar applications will exceed 70% … by 2030, … the adoption rate of new-generation intelligent terminals, AI agents and similar applications will exceed 90%

title: 《数字中国发展报告（2025年）》
title_en: Digital China Development Report (2025)
summary: 报告 2026-04-29 发布、全文 2026-06-08 公开。另含：网民 11.25 亿；AI 解答问题/生成图片视频/生活助手用户 4.57/2.88/1.84 亿；40 岁以下中青年用户占 74.6%；截至 2025 年底累计建成 3.5 万余家基础级、8200 余家先进级、500 余家卓越级智能工厂，培育 15 家领航级智能工厂；枢纽地区新增算力占全国新增 80% 以上；超大型算力设施平均 PUE 降至 1.34。
summary_en: Report released on 2026-04-29, full text published on 2026-06-08. Also includes: 1.125 billion internet users; users using AI to answer questions / generate images and video / as an everyday assistant: 457 / 288 / 184 million; young and middle-aged users under 40 make up 74.6%; by the end of 2025, more than 35,000 basic-level, more than 8,200 advanced-level and more than 500 excellence-level smart factories had been built, and 15 pioneer-level smart factories cultivated; hub regions accounted for over 80% of new computing power added nationwide; the average PUE of hyperscale computing facilities fell to 1.34.
quote: 截至2025年底，全国在用算力设施机架数超过1373万标准机架，建成万卡智算集群42个，智能算力规模达到159万PFLOPS（FP16，下同），位居全球第二。
quote_en: As of the end of 2025, racks in computing facilities in use nationwide exceeded 13.73 million standard racks, 42 ten-thousand-card AI computing clusters had been built, and AI computing power reached 1.59 million PFLOPS (FP16, same below), ranking second in the world.

World Robotics 2026 was released on 2026-09-24 (with 2025 data), but the IFR’s free public materials do not yet give 2025 robot density by country, so 2024 values are still used.

quote: The source defines AI models as "large-scale" when their training compute is confirmed to exceed 10²³ floating-point operations.
